why_it_fits: Uses fruit that is very ripe but still sound, without mold, off odors, or other spoilage.
steps: Wash fruit; hull and halve.
Simmer fruit with lemon juice and sugar for 8–12 minutes until softened.
Mash, turn off heat, stir in chia seeds, and cool.
Refrigerate promptly and eat within a few days.

title: Strawberry Balsamic Bruschetta
summary: A savory toast with strawberries and basil.
why_it_fits: Matches the selected fruit and the ripeness shown in the image.
steps: Wash, hull and chop strawberries.
Spread toast with cream cheese.
Top with berries, basil and a few drops of balsamic.

title: Strawberry Lemon Smoothie
summary: A tart, chilled smoothie showcasing strawberry.
why_it_fits: Matches the selected fruit and the ripeness shown in the image.
steps: Wash fruit; hull and halve.
Blend all ingredients until smooth.
Taste and add a little water if needed.

title: Strawberry Oat Pancake Topping
summary: A warm strawberry topping for pancakes or oatmeal.
why_it_fits: Uses fruit that is very ripe but still sound, without mold, off odors, or other spoilage.
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups ripe or soft, sound strawberry
steps: Wash fruit; hull and halve.
Simmer fruit with water for 5–8 minutes until saucy.
Add maple syrup and optional flavoring; spoon over oatmeal or pancakes.

title: Strawberry Yogurt Parfait
summary: A layered bowl with ripe strawberry and a crunchy topping.
why_it_fits: Matches the selected fruit and the ripeness shown in the image.
steps: Wash fruit; hull and halve.
Layer fruit, yogurt and granola in two glasses.
Drizzle with sweetener if desired and serve.

title: Tart Strawberry Compote
summary: Balances the sharpness of firm, underripe strawberry with gentle cooking.
why_it_fits: Cooking and controlled sweetness help make tart underripe berries usable; never use moldy or damaged berries.
steps: Wash fruit; hull and halve.
Simmer with water and sugar until tender, 10–15 minutes.
Taste once cooked; add lemon juice only if needed.

title: Tamarind Cooler
summary: A tangy chilled tamarind drink.
why_it_fits: Matches the selected fruit and the ripeness shown in the image.
steps: Remove shells and seeds from tamarind.
Soak pulp in warm water 10 minutes; mash and strain.
Stir in sugar, chill and serve over ice.

title: Tamarind-Date Chutney
summary: Sweet-tart chutney from ripe tamarind pulp.
why_it_fits: Matches the selected fruit and the ripeness shown in the image.
steps: Remove all tamarind shells, fibers and seeds; pit dates.
Simmer pulp, dates and water for 12 minutes.
Blend smooth, strain if needed, add cumin and sugar, and refrigerate.

title: Tamarind Simmer Sauce
summary: A cooked tangy sauce made with sound tamarind pulp.
why_it_fits: Uses fruit that is very ripe but still sound, without mold, off odors, or other spoilage.
steps: Remove all shells and seeds.
Simmer pulp with water, sugar, soy sauce and ginger for 8–10 minutes.
Strain if desired and refrigerate promptly.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
summary: Crunchy skillet-fried firm green tomatoes.
why_it_fits: Matches the selected fruit and the ripeness shown in the image.
steps: Wash and cut tomatoes into 1/4-inch slices.
Dust with flour, dip in beaten egg, and coat in cornmeal.
Pan-fry until golden on both sides and cooked; season lightly.

title: Slow Simmered Tomato Sauce
summary: A simple sauce for soft, sound tomatoes.
why_it_fits: Uses fruit that is very ripe but still sound, without mold, off odors, or other spoilage.
steps: Wash and chop tomatoes; discard any showing mold, leaking, or off odors.
Cook minced garlic in olive oil for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, salt and oregano; simmer 25–35 minutes until thick.

title: Tomato Basil Salad
summary: Fresh tomato slices with basil.
why_it_fits: Matches the selected fruit and the ripeness shown in the image.
steps: Wash and slice tomatoes.
Arrange with basil; drizzle with oil and lemon.
Season to taste and serve.

title: Tomato & White Bean Toast
summary: Warm beans and tomatoes on toast.
why_it_fits: Uses fruit that is very ripe but still sound, without mold, off odors, or other spoilage.
steps: Wash and dice tomatoes.
Warm chopped garlic, tomatoes and beans with oil for 8 minutes.
Spoon over toasted bread.

title: Chilled Watermelon Smoothie
summary: A light smoothie made with cold watermelon.
why_it_fits: Matches the selected fruit and the ripeness shown in the image.
steps: Wash the melon exterior; remove the rind and any large seeds; cube the flesh.
Blend all ingredients until smooth.
Serve immediately and keep leftovers refrigerated.

title: Watermelon Feta Salad
summary: A salty-sweet summer salad.
why_it_fits: Matches the selected fruit and the ripeness shown in the image.
steps: Wash the watermelon rind before cutting; remove rind and seeds.
Toss cubed watermelon with cucumber and lime.
Top with feta and mint.

title: Watermelon Granita
summary: An icy dessert for sweet, sound watermelon flesh.
why_it_fits: Works with very ripe melon only when it remains sound and properly refrigerated; never use mushy or suspect melon. Use only fruit without signs of spoilage.
steps: Wash the melon exterior; remove the rind and any large seeds; cube the flesh. Use only properly chilled, sound fruit.
Blend the flesh with lime and honey.
Freeze in a shallow tray; rake with a fork every 45 minutes until fluffy ice crystals form.

title: Watermelon Lime & Mint Cups
summary: A refreshing chilled watermelon salad.
why_it_fits: Matches the selected fruit and the ripeness shown in the image.
steps: Wash the outside of the melon; remove the rind and any large seeds; cube the flesh.
Gently toss cubes with lime juice, herbs and a pinch of salt.
Serve cold immediately.
